## ----------------------------------------------------------------------
## Shiny app: simulating hypothesis tests
##
## Repeatedly draws samples of size n, computes a test statistic for H0
## from each sample, and shows how often H0 is rejected -- illustrating
## Type I error (when the true parameter equals the H0 value) or power
## (when it doesn't), plus the sampling distribution of the test
## statistic against its theoretical reference distribution.
##
## Five test types:
##   - Mean, normal population, known variance     -> z test
##   - Mean, normal population, unknown variance    -> t test
##   - Mean, large sample, various distributions    -> z test (CLT)
##   - Variance, normal population                  -> chi-square test
##   - Proportion                                    -> z test
##
## To run:
##   install.packages("shiny")   # first time only
##   shiny::runApp("app.R")
## ----------------------------------------------------------------------

library(shiny)

## ---- Simulation functions ------------------------------------------
## Each returns a data.frame with columns: statistic, p_value, reject (0/1)

pval_from_stat <- function(stat, alternative, pfun, ...) {
  switch(
    alternative,
    two.sided = 2 * pmin(pfun(stat, ...), 1 - pfun(stat, ...)),
    less      = pfun(stat, ...),
    greater   = 1 - pfun(stat, ...)
  )
}

simulate_mean_known <- function(n_sim, n, mu, sigma, mu0, alpha, alternative) {
  z <- sapply(seq_len(n_sim), function(i) {
    x <- rnorm(n, mu, sigma)
    (mean(x) - mu0) / (sigma / sqrt(n))
  })
  p <- pval_from_stat(z, alternative, pnorm)
  data.frame(statistic = z, p_value = pmin(p, 1), reject = as.numeric(p < alpha))
}

simulate_mean_unknown <- function(n_sim, n, mu, sigma, mu0, alpha, alternative) {
  t_val <- sapply(seq_len(n_sim), function(i) {
    x <- rnorm(n, mu, sigma)
    (mean(x) - mu0) / (sd(x) / sqrt(n))
  })
  p <- pval_from_stat(t_val, alternative, pt, df = n - 1)
  data.frame(statistic = t_val, p_value = pmin(p, 1), reject = as.numeric(p < alpha))
}

draw_clt_sample <- function(n, dist, par1, par2) {
  switch(
    dist,
    uniform     = runif(n, par1, par2),
    exponential = rexp(n, rate = par1),
    chisq       = rchisq(n, df = par1),
    bernoulli   = rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = par1)
  )
}

clt_true_mean <- function(dist, par1, par2) {
  switch(
    dist,
    uniform     = (par1 + par2) / 2,
    exponential = 1 / par1,
    chisq       = par1,
    bernoulli   = par1
  )
}

simulate_mean_clt <- function(n_sim, n, dist, par1, par2, mu0, alpha, alternative) {
  z <- sapply(seq_len(n_sim), function(i) {
    x <- draw_clt_sample(n, dist, par1, par2)
    (mean(x) - mu0) / (sd(x) / sqrt(n))
  })
  p <- pval_from_stat(z, alternative, pnorm)
  data.frame(statistic = z, p_value = pmin(p, 1), reject = as.numeric(p < alpha))
}

simulate_variance <- function(n_sim, n, mu, sigma2, sigma2_0, alpha, alternative) {
  chi <- sapply(seq_len(n_sim), function(i) {
    x <- rnorm(n, mu, sqrt(sigma2))
    (n - 1) * var(x) / sigma2_0
  })
  p <- pval_from_stat(chi, alternative, pchisq, df = n - 1)
  data.frame(statistic = chi, p_value = pmin(p, 1), reject = as.numeric(p < alpha))
}

simulate_proportion <- function(n_sim, n, p_true, p0, alpha, alternative) {
  z <- sapply(seq_len(n_sim), function(i) {
    x <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = p_true)
    phat <- mean(x)
    (phat - p0) / sqrt(p0 * (1 - p0) / n)
  })
  p <- pval_from_stat(z, alternative, pnorm)
  data.frame(statistic = z, p_value = pmin(p, 1), reject = as.numeric(p < alpha))
}

## ---- UI ---------------------------------------------------------------

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Simulating hypothesis tests"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText(
        "Repeatedly samples size n, runs the chosen test against H0, and",
        " shows the sampling distribution of the test statistic plus the",
        " empirical rejection rate. If the true parameter equals the H0",
        " value, that rate estimates the ", strong("Type I error"),
        "; if it differs, it estimates ", strong("power"), "."
      ),

      selectInput(
        "test_type", "Type of test:",
        choices = c(
          "Mean, normal population, known variance (z test)"    = "mean_known",
          "Mean, normal population, unknown variance (t test)"  = "mean_unknown",
          "Mean, large sample, various distributions (CLT, z test)" = "mean_clt",
          "Variance, normal population (chi-square test)"       = "variance",
          "Proportion (z test)"                                 = "proportion"
        )
      ),

      selectInput(
        "alternative", "Alternative hypothesis:",
        choices = c("Two-sided (≠)" = "two.sided",
                    "Less than (<)"      = "less",
                    "Greater than (>)"   = "greater")
      ),

      sliderInput("n", "Sample size (n):", min = 2, max = 500, value = 30, step = 1),
      sliderInput("n_sim", "Number of simulated samples:",
                  min = 50, max = 2000, value = 500, step = 50),
      sliderInput("alpha", "Significance level (α):",
                  min = 0.01, max = 0.2, value = 0.05, step = 0.01),

      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.test_type == 'mean_known'",
        numericInput("mkn_mu0", "H0 value (μ₀):", value = 0, step = 1),
        numericInput("mkn_mu",  "True population mean (μ):", value = 0, step = 1),
        numericInput("mkn_sigma", "True (known) standard deviation (σ):",
                     value = 1, min = 0.01, step = 0.1)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.test_type == 'mean_unknown'",
        numericInput("mun_mu0", "H0 value (μ₀):", value = 0, step = 1),
        numericInput("mun_mu",  "True population mean (μ):", value = 0, step = 1),
        numericInput("mun_sigma", "True population standard deviation (σ):",
                     value = 1, min = 0.01, step = 0.1)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.test_type == 'mean_clt'",
        selectInput("clt_dist", "Underlying distribution:",
                    choices = c("Uniform" = "uniform", "Exponential" = "exponential",
                                "Chi-squared" = "chisq", "Bernoulli" = "bernoulli")),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.clt_dist == 'uniform'",
          numericInput("clt_a", "Lower bound (a):", value = 0, step = 1),
          numericInput("clt_b", "Upper bound (b):", value = 10, step = 1)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.clt_dist == 'exponential'",
          numericInput("clt_rate", "Rate:", value = 0.5, min = 0.01, step = 0.1)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.clt_dist == 'chisq'",
          numericInput("clt_df", "Degrees of freedom:", value = 3, min = 1, step = 1)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.clt_dist == 'bernoulli'",
          sliderInput("clt_prob", "Probability:", min = 0.01, max = 0.99, value = 0.3, step = 0.01)
        ),
        numericInput("clt_mu0", "H0 value (μ₀):", value = 5, step = 0.5),
        uiOutput("clt_true_mean_note")
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.test_type == 'variance'",
        numericInput("var_sigma2_0", "H0 value (σ₀²):", value = 1, min = 0.01, step = 0.1),
        numericInput("var_mu", "True population mean (μ, any value):", value = 0, step = 1),
        numericInput("var_sigma2", "True population variance (σ²):",
                     value = 1, min = 0.01, step = 0.1)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.test_type == 'proportion'",
        sliderInput("prop_p0", "H0 value (p₀):", min = 0.01, max = 0.99, value = 0.5, step = 0.01),
        sliderInput("prop_p", "True proportion (p):", min = 0.01, max = 0.99, value = 0.5, step = 0.01)
      ),

      actionButton("resample", "Resimulate", icon = icon("rotate-right")),

      hr(),
      h4("Results"),
      tableOutput("results_table")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("test_plot", height = "480px"),

      br(),
      p(
        "The curve is the theoretical distribution of the test statistic",
        " under H0. The blue dots and segments mark the critical value(s)",
        " for the chosen α and alternative. Each small point on the",
        " x-axis is one simulated sample's test statistic — ",
        strong("black"), " if that sample does not reject H0, ",
        strong("red"), " if it does."
      )
    )
  )
)

## ---- Server ------------------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  rv <- reactiveValues(seed = 1)
  observeEvent(input$resample, { rv$seed <- rv$seed + 1 })
  observeEvent(list(
    input$test_type, input$alternative, input$n, input$n_sim, input$alpha,
    input$mkn_mu0, input$mkn_mu, input$mkn_sigma,
    input$mun_mu0, input$mun_mu, input$mun_sigma,
    input$clt_dist, input$clt_a, input$clt_b, input$clt_rate, input$clt_df,
    input$clt_prob, input$clt_mu0,
    input$var_sigma2_0, input$var_mu, input$var_sigma2,
    input$prop_p0, input$prop_p
  ), { rv$seed <- rv$seed + 1 }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  output$clt_true_mean_note <- renderUI({
    par1 <- switch(input$clt_dist,
      uniform = input$clt_a, exponential = input$clt_rate,
      chisq = input$clt_df, bernoulli = input$clt_prob)
    par2 <- if (input$clt_dist == "uniform") input$clt_b else NA
    req(par1)
    tm <- clt_true_mean(input$clt_dist, par1, par2)
    helpText(paste0("True mean of this distribution: ", round(tm, 3)))
  })

  sim_results <- reactive({
    rv$seed
    set.seed(rv$seed + 123)
    tt <- input$test_type
    a  <- input$alpha
    alt <- input$alternative

    if (tt == "mean_known") {
      req(input$mkn_mu0, input$mkn_mu, input$mkn_sigma)
      list(
        data = simulate_mean_known(input$n_sim, input$n, input$mkn_mu, input$mkn_sigma,
                                    input$mkn_mu0, a, alt),
        ref = list(d = function(x) dnorm(x), q = function(p) qnorm(p)),
        true_equals_null = isTRUE(all.equal(input$mkn_mu, input$mkn_mu0)),
        label = "z"
      )
    } else if (tt == "mean_unknown") {
      req(input$mun_mu0, input$mun_mu, input$mun_sigma)
      list(
        data = simulate_mean_unknown(input$n_sim, input$n, input$mun_mu, input$mun_sigma,
                                      input$mun_mu0, a, alt),
        ref = list(d = function(x) dt(x, df = input$n - 1), q = function(p) qt(p, df = input$n - 1)),
        true_equals_null = isTRUE(all.equal(input$mun_mu, input$mun_mu0)),
        label = "t"
      )
    } else if (tt == "mean_clt") {
      par1 <- switch(input$clt_dist,
        uniform = input$clt_a, exponential = input$clt_rate,
        chisq = input$clt_df, bernoulli = input$clt_prob)
      par2 <- if (input$clt_dist == "uniform") input$clt_b else NA
      req(par1, input$clt_mu0)
      tm <- clt_true_mean(input$clt_dist, par1, par2)
      list(
        data = simulate_mean_clt(input$n_sim, input$n, input$clt_dist, par1, par2,
                                  input$clt_mu0, a, alt),
        ref = list(d = function(x) dnorm(x), q = function(p) qnorm(p)),
        true_equals_null = isTRUE(all.equal(tm, input$clt_mu0, tolerance = 1e-6)),
        label = "z"
      )
    } else if (tt == "variance") {
      req(input$var_sigma2_0, input$var_mu, input$var_sigma2)
      list(
        data = simulate_variance(input$n_sim, input$n, input$var_mu, input$var_sigma2,
                                  input$var_sigma2_0, a, alt),
        ref = list(d = function(x) dchisq(x, df = input$n - 1), q = function(p) qchisq(p, df = input$n - 1)),
        true_equals_null = isTRUE(all.equal(input$var_sigma2, input$var_sigma2_0)),
        label = "χ²"
      )
    } else {
      req(input$prop_p0, input$prop_p)
      list(
        data = simulate_proportion(input$n_sim, input$n, input$prop_p, input$prop_p0, a, alt),
        ref = list(d = function(x) dnorm(x), q = function(p) qnorm(p)),
        true_equals_null = isTRUE(all.equal(input$prop_p, input$prop_p0)),
        label = "z"
      )
    }
  })

  critical_values <- reactive({
    res <- sim_results()
    a <- input$alpha
    q <- res$ref$q
    switch(
      input$alternative,
      two.sided = c(q(a / 2), q(1 - a / 2)),
      less      = c(q(a), NA),
      greater   = c(NA, q(1 - a))
    )
  })

  output$test_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- sim_results()
    d <- res$data
    cv <- critical_values()
    rej_rate <- mean(d$reject)

    xr <- range(c(d$statistic, cv[is.finite(cv)]), na.rm = TRUE)
    pad <- max(diff(xr) * 0.1, 0.5)
    xseq <- seq(xr[1] - pad, xr[2] + pad, length.out = 500)
    dens <- res$ref$d(xseq)

    plot(
      xseq, dens, type = "l", lwd = 1.5,
      xlab = res$label, ylab = paste0("f(", res$label, ")"),
      main = paste0(
        "n = ", input$n, "  —  ", round(100 * rej_rate, 1),
        "% of simulated samples reject H0"
      )
    )
    abline(h = 0)

    # critical value(s), drawn as in the original script: a vertical blue
    # segment up to the curve, with a blue point at its base
    for (v in cv[is.finite(cv)]) {
      segments(v, 0, v, res$ref$d(v), col = "blue")
      points(v, 0, pch = 20, col = "blue")
    }

    text(
      mean(xr), max(dens) * 0.6,
      paste0("1 - α = ", 1 - input$alpha),
      cex = 1.5, col = "blue"
    )

    # each simulated sample's test statistic, plotted on the axis:
    # black if it does not reject H0, red (larger) if it does
    not_rej <- d$statistic[d$reject == 0]
    rej     <- d$statistic[d$reject == 1]
    points(not_rej, rep(0, length(not_rej)), pch = 20, col = "black", cex = 0.8)
    points(rej,     rep(0, length(rej)),     pch = 20, col = "red",   cex = 1.2)
  })

  output$results_table <- renderTable({
    res <- sim_results()
    d <- res$data
    rej_rate <- mean(d$reject)
    data.frame(
      Quantity = c("Significance level (α)",
                   if (res$true_equals_null) "Empirical Type I error" else "Empirical power",
                   "Samples rejecting H0", "Mean test statistic"),
      Value = c(
        paste0(round(input$alpha * 100, 1), "%"),
        paste0(round(100 * rej_rate, 1), "%"),
        paste0(sum(d$reject), " / ", nrow(d)),
        round(mean(d$statistic), 4)
      )
    )
  }, colnames = FALSE)
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
